message.content:
This editorial illustration shows the front cover of Tempo magazine, dated "EDISI 20-26 MEI 2013." Against a plain white background, a large, weathered white metal box resembling a ballot box sits angled toward the viewer. The box is cube-shaped with a metallic handle and a narrow slot on top. It is secured with a green latch and a gold-colored padlock on its front face. The box's surface appears worn with dark streaks and grime. 

The left face of the box features bold black and red text: "SELINGKUH FATHANAH DAN PARTAI DAKWAH." The right face has a black and gold rectangular emblem with a crescent moon and rice stalk design, below which "SEJAHTERA" is partially visible. A small vertical slit on this right side has a piece of paper currency partially inserted. 

At the top, the large red word "TEMPO" dominates. Above it, smaller gray text reads "REKENING GENDUT BINTARA TERKAYA" and "KASAK-KUSUK PENETAPAN MENTERI KEUANGAN BARU." The bottom left corner displays the price "RP 33.000," a website address, and a barcode.
